decision: 5 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 2 for the 12 month period) Reason The Stewards reviewed video, and in-car video evidence. At and from the apex of Turn 6, Car 20 was on the outside and was clearly level and then in front of Car 21. In accordance with the Driving Standards Guidelines, Car 20 should have been given racing room.
fact: Car 21 forced Car 20 off the track at turn 6.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV Article 2b of the International Sporting Code
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 21 Forcing Another Driver Off The Track
